Scene bundles the arm64 macOS whisper-cli from ggml-org/whisper.cpp, commit 927cfce34f31707e17f2bff35c349632fb9e2c3a (v1.9.4).
Source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/tree/927cfce34f31707e17f2bff35c349632fb9e2c3a
License: MIT; see LICENSE.
The binary was built with CMake Release, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF and GGML_METAL=OFF. SHA-256: 9c792865783308ab69c00df7ba20078d7a14a9fe14aec388e2426d109d6ffb4c.
The multilingual base model is downloaded on first use from https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-base.bin and checked against SHA-256 60ed5bc3dd14eea856493d334349b405782ddcaf0028d4b5df4088345fba2efe.
